Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in the very first analysis step. After the WebSurfer correctly identified Anastasia of Serbia's husband as Stefan Nemanja (who ruled 1166–1196), the Planner incorrectly claimed that the husband was "Stefan Prvovenčani, who ruled from 1196 to 1228." This is historically inaccurate; Stefan Prvovenčani is the son of Stefan Nemanja and Anastasia. By conflating the father (Stefan Nemanja) with the son (Stefan Prvovenčani), the Planner directed all subsequent searches toward the wrong person, leading to a search for the death of the King rather than the death of the husband (Stefan Nemanja, who died in the city of Ras in 1196).
